### Reshaping the data
```{r}
### Rename all CN_annot names for analysis in R
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("B cell priming zone", "B_cell_priming_zone", df$CN_k20_n25_annot )
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("Bulk tumor", "Bulk_tumor", df$CN_k20_n25_annot)
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("CAF-enriched stroma", "CAF_enriched_stroma", df$CN_k20_n25_annot)
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("Granulocyte-enriched", "Granulocyte_enriched", df$CN_k20_n25_annot)
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("Myeloid-cell enriched immune infiltrate", "Myeloid_cell_enriched_immune_infiltrate", df$CN_k20_n25_annot )
df$CN_k20_n25_annot  <- gsub("Plasma-cell enriched immune infiltrate", "Plasma_cell_enriched_immune_infiltrate", df$CN_k20_n25_annot )
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("T cell priming and activation", "Tcell_priming_and_activation", df$CN_k20_n25_annot )
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("Tumor boundary", "Tumor_boundary", df$CN_k20_n25_annot )
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("Vessel-enriched stroma", "Vessel_enriched_stroma", df$CN_k20_n25_annot)

df$cell_types_lowres <- gsub("B lymphocytes", "B_lymphocytes", df$cell_types_lowres )
df$cell_types_lowres <- gsub("T lymphocytes", "T_lymphocytes", df$cell_types_lowres)
df$cell_types_lowres <- gsub("other leukocytes", "other_leukocytes", df$cell_types_lowres)
df$cell_types_lowres <- gsub("myeloid cells", "myeloid_cells", df$cell_types_lowres)
```


# Figure 2C: Create piecharts to compare major cell type abundances between VP and VN condition
```{r}
df$cell_types_lowres <- factor(df$cell_types_lowres, levels = c("tumor", "epithelial", "stroma", "other_leukocytes", "myeloid_cells", "B_lymphocytes", "T_lymphocytes"))

contingency_table <- table(df$cell_types_lowres, df$MCPyV_status_Nolan)
print(contingency_table)

# Calculate relative counts
relative_counts <- prop.table(contingency_table, margin = 2)
print(relative_counts)

# Load necessary library
library(ggplot2)

# Convert the contingency table to a data frame
df_counts <- as.data.frame(contingency_table)
colnames(df_counts) <- c("Cell.types.coarse", "Viral.status", "count")

# Calculate relative counts
df_counts$relative_count <- ave(df_counts$count, df_counts$Viral.status, FUN = function(x) x / sum(x))

create_labels <- function(counts, rel_counts) {
  labels <- paste0(counts$compartment, "\n", 
                   "Abs: ", counts$count, "\n", 
                   "Rel: ", round(rel_counts$relative_count * 100, 1), "%")
  return(labels)
}

# Separate data frames for each status
df_positive <- subset(df_counts, Viral.status == "positive")
df_negative <- subset(df_counts, Viral.status == "negative")

labels_positive <- create_labels(df_positive, df_positive)
labels_negative <- create_labels(df_negative, df_negative)



piechart_CTlowres_VP <- ggplot(df_positive, aes(x = "", y = relative_count, fill = Cell.types.coarse)) +
  geom_bar(width = 1, stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(relative_count * 100, 1), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 5) +
  labs(title = "Main compartments VP-MCC") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_cell_types_lowres_new) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
piechart_CTlowres_VP

piechart_CTlowres_VN <- ggplot(df_negative, aes(x = "", y = relative_count, fill = Cell.types.coarse)) +
  geom_bar(width = 1, stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(relative_count * 100, 1), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 5) +
  labs(title = "Main compartments VN-MCC") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_cell_types_lowres_new) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
piechart_CTlowres_VN

output_dir <- "/Users/maxhaist/Nolan Lab Dropbox/Maximilian Haist/MCC_project/Output_R_analysis/Figure2/overview_heatmaps_stacked_barplots/pie_charts_cell_types_lowres/"

ggsave(plot = piechart_CTlowres_VP, filename = paste0(output_dir, "Piechart_celltypes_lowres_VP.pdf"), dpi = 600)
ggsave(plot = piechart_CTlowres_VN, filename = paste0(output_dir, "Piechart_celltypes_lowres_VN.pdf"), dpi = 600)
```

# Figure 2E: Waterfall plot to show aggregate statistics for cell type abundances in VP vs VN MCC
```{r}
df_filt <- subset(df, cell_types_lowres %in% c("myeloid_cells", "T_lymphocytes", "B_lymphocytes", "other_leukocytes", "stroma"))

p1 <- celltype_log2c <- df_filt %>% 
  group_by(cell_types_mediumres, MCPyV_status_Nolan) %>% 
  dplyr::count() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(MCPyV_status_Nolan) %>% 
  mutate(total_n = sum(n)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(cell_types_mediumres) %>% 
  mutate(diff = log2((lag(n)/lag(total_n)) / (n/total_n))) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(cell_types_mediumres, diff), y = diff, fill = cell_types_mediumres)) +
  geom_col() + 
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, ymin = 0, xmax = Inf, ymax = Inf), fill = 'royalblue', alpha = 0.02) + 
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, ymin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymax = 0), fill = 'red', alpha = 0.02) + 
  #annotate('text', x = 2, y = 1.5, label = 'EBV+', size = 12) +
  #annotate('text', x = 13, y = -1, label = 'EBV-', size = 12) +
  labs(x = 'Major cell types', y = 'log2fold enrichment', title = 'Cell type enrichment (VP/VN)') + 
  scale_fill_manual('Cell Types', values = colors_cell_common, na.value = 'white') +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = 'none',
        text = element_text(size = 12))
p1
  
ggsave('/Users/maxhaist/Nolan Lab Dropbox/Maximilian Haist/MCC_project/Output_R_analysis/Figure2/overview_heatmaps_stacked_barplots/test/celltype_log2c_with_stroma.pdf', celltype_log2c, dpi = 320)
```

# Figure 2H: Comparison of MHC-I expression in VP vs VN-MCC
```{r}
df_MCPyV_MHCI <- df_clin_metadata_TMA_core_num[, c("Pat_ID", "TMA_core_num", "MCPyV_status_Nolan", "MHCI_IHC_summary")]
df_MCPyV_MHCI$MCPyV_status_Nolan <- gsub("0", "negative", df_MCPyV_MHCI$MCPyV_status_Nolan )
df_MCPyV_MHCI$MCPyV_status_Nolan <- gsub("1", "positive", df_MCPyV_MHCI$MCPyV_status_Nolan )

df_filter_stats <- df_MCPyV_MHCI[, c("MCPyV_status_Nolan", "MHCI_IHC_summary")]

my_order <- c("low", "intermediate", "positive")

# Convert MHCI_IHC_summary to a categorical variable with the desired order
df_filter_stats$MHCI_IHC_summary <- factor(df_filter_stats$MHCI_IHC_summary, levels = my_order)
df_filter_stats <- df_filter_stats[order(df_filter_stats$MHCI_IHC_summary), ]

my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "orange", "maroon"))(n = 100)
my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("royalblue", "white", "red"))(n = 100)
library(corrplot)

### Now make the corrplot
chisq <- chisq.test(df_filter_stats$MCPyV_status_Nolan, df_filter_stats$MHCI_IHC_summary)
chisq$observed
corrplot(chisq$residuals, is.cor = FALSE, method = c("square"), type = c("full"), addCoefasPercent = TRUE, outline = TRUE, title = "Correlation_MHCI_v_MCPyV", tl.col = "black", tl.pos = "lt", col = my_palette)
round(chisq$residuals, 3)

pdf(file = "/Users/maxhaist/Nolan Lab Dropbox/Maximilian Haist/MCC_project/Output_R_analysis/MCPyV_features_correlations/Corrplot_MCPyV_v_MHCI_030724.pdf", height = 6, width = 10)
corrplot(chisq$residuals, is.cor = FALSE, method = c("square"), type = c("full"), addCoefasPercent = TRUE, outline = TRUE, title = "Correlation_MHCI_v_MCPyV", tl.col = "black", tl.pos = "lt", col = my_palette)
dev.off()
```
